headline: KIB successfully prices its first issuance of unsecured priority sukuk worth $500 million
summary: Kuwait International Bank priced its first unsecured priority sukuk worth $500 million. The five-year tenor carries a margin of 95 basis points and an annual profit rate of 5.502 percent.
why: Sukuk are Islamic finance instruments, and bank issuance of this kind shows funding access in international and regional debt markets.
